name: project_timesheet
summary: Weekly timesheets, effort entries, independent approval and locking
description: Record employee effort against project tasks on a weekly timesheet, classify entries billable or non-billable, and route each sheet through an independent review (draft to submitted to approved/rejected) with separation of duties so a submitter never approves their own time. Approval derives a task's spent hours and locks the sheet; a controlled reopen re-derives them so effort figures never drift. Payroll and invoicing remain owned by HR and Accounting; this module only records and rolls up effort.
author: Nexa
